summary: Regentis Biomaterials Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American (RGNT), filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 12, 2026 reporting surgeon engagement for its GelrinC cartilage implant at the 8th ICRS Summit held October 8-10, 2026, in Porto, Portugal. The release describes CE Mark approval in Europe, expansion of Centers of Excellence, and European sites supporting an ongoing U.S. FDA pivotal Phase III trial. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is disclosed; the filing is a routine product and commercialization update, not a special situation.
